cases.desc: Verify FAQ list displays questions and answers from API.
cases.expected: FAQ accordion list should display all questions.
cases.approach: unit-testable - after fetchFaq resolves with two items the loader clears and both questions show as cards; a stored list shows every question closed

cases.desc: Verify FAQ answer expands when user taps question.
cases.approach: unit-testable - pressing a card sets expanded true and shows its answer under the question while the other card stays closed

cases.desc: Verify FAQ answer collapses when user taps expanded question again.
cases.approach: unit-testable - pressing the open card again sets expanded false and removes its answer

cases.desc: Verify HTML content in FAQ answer renders correctly.
cases.approach: unit-testable - an answer with bold, list and link markup shows bold style, two bullet markers and a link that opens through Linking

cases.desc: Verify FAQ screen handles empty response array.
cases.expected: Empty state/no rows should display without crash.
cases.approach: unit-testable - an empty array with nothing stored shows 'No FAQs are available right now.' with no Retry button and no loader

cases.desc: Verify FAQ API failure uses cache when available.
cases.approach: unit-testable - with a stored list and a rejected request the stored question stays on screen and no error message, Retry or loader appears

cases.desc: Verify FAQ API failure with no cache shows error.
cases.expected: Server error popup or empty fallback should display.
cases.approach: unit-testable - divergent: case expects a server error popup or empty fallback; recorded plan decision 3 (owner, 2026-11-06) shows an in-page error message with Retry and no dialog

cases.desc: Verify FAQ route revisit refreshes data.
cases.expected: FAQ content should refresh as per route logic.
cases.approach: unit-testable - a second focus requests the list again (two calls), the new list replaces the old one on screen and in the store

cases.desc: Verify long FAQ question text wraps properly.
cases.expected: Question text should be readable without truncation issues.
cases.approach: unit-testable - a long question has no numberOfLines, no ellipsizeMode and no fixed height, so it wraps in full

cases.desc: Verify long FAQ answer text is scrollable/readable.
cases.approach: unit-testable - a 400-word answer renders as one text with no numberOfLines, height or maxHeight, so it shows in full

cases.desc: Verify invalid FAQ response structure is normalized safely.
cases.expected: FAQ list should not crash and should show empty/fallback state.
cases.approach: unit-testable - a non-array answer with nothing stored shows the empty message and no items without a crash

cases.expected: User should return to non-logged home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - pressing Back calls navigate with the NonLoggedInHome route

cases.desc: Verify FAQ list remains stable during rapid expand/collapse.
cases.expected: No UI freeze or crash should occur.
cases.approach: unit-testable - ten rapid presses on one card end consistent (closed) and the other card never flips, with no error thrown

cases.desc: Verify loader appears during FAQ fetch.
cases.expected: Loader should display until response received.
cases.approach: unit-testable - the loader is shown while the request is pending and is gone once the answer arrives

cases.desc: Verify FAQ content does not call track application API.
cases.expected: Only FAQ endpoint should be used for FAQ content.
cases.approach: unit-testable - with the real FAQ service and a stubbed transport, opening and returning send exactly two requests to FormBasedQuery/Services/v1/fetch-faq and none to a track URL

cases.desc: Verify FAQ accessibility content is readable by screen reader labels where applicable.
cases.expected: FAQ controls should be focusable/readable as per app behavior.
cases.approach: unit-testable - every card is a button labelled with its question and exposes an expanded state; the title is a heading; reading order is title, Back, cards
unit-testable - a rejected request (network failure) with nothing stored shows the exact error message and Retry and the loader clears

cases.desc: Verify FAQ data does not persist incorrectly after logout/session reset.
cases.expected: Latest or safely cached FAQ data should display.
cases.approach: unit-testable - partial: after the stored list is cleared the hook shows loading and the next open loads and shows a new list; blocked: session-reset (logout) module, sessionService.logout does not dispatch clearFaq
